[{"node_id": "0001", "title": "Process Instruction PI-0042", "level": 1, "page_start": 1, "page_end": 1, "text": "Assembly of the KP-200 Pump Unit. Kestrel Industrial, revision 4 (fictional demo data).", "summary": "Assembly of the KP-200 Pump Unit.", "children": []}, {"node_id": "0002", "title": "1 Scope", "level": 1, "page_start": 1, "page_end": 1, "text": "This process instruction covers the assembly of the KP-200 pump unit from inspected components at the Kestrel assembly line, station A3.", "summary": "This process instruction covers the assembly of the KP-200 pump unit from inspected components at the Kestrel assembly line, station A3.", "children": []}, {"node_id": "0003", "title": "2 Safety", "level": 1, "page_start": 1, "page_end": 1, "text": "Wear safety shoes, gloves and eye protection.

Use the overhead hoist for the casing (78 kg). Never lift by the shaft.", "summary": "Wear safety shoes, gloves and eye protection.", "children": []}, {"node_id": "0004", "title": "3 Tools and Fixtures", "level": 1, "page_start": 1, "page_end": 1, "text": "Bearing induction heater, set to 110 C.

Torque wrench 20-200 Nm, calibrated.

Seal setting gauge 42.5 mm.

Dial indicator with magnetic base.", "summary": "Bearing induction heater, set to 110 C.", "children": []}, {"node_id": "0005", "title": "4 Bearing Housing Sub-Assembly", "level": 1, "page_start": 1, "page_end": 1, "text": "", "summary": "Covers: 4.1 Prepare the Housing; 4.2 Fit the Bearings; 4.3 Fit the Lip Seals", "children": [{"node_id": "0006", "title": "4.1 Prepare the Housing", "level": 2, "page_start": 1, "page_end": 1, "text": "- 1. Clean the bearing housing bores and check them for burrs.
- 2. Record the housing serial number on the route card.", "summary": "Clean the bearing housing bores and check them for burrs.", "children": []}, {"node_id": "0007", "title": "4.2 Fit the Bearings", "level": 2, "page_start": 1, "page_end": 1, "text": "- 1. Heat each bearing (KP-200-130) to 110 C on the induction heater.
- 2. Slide the bearing onto the shaft (KP-200-110) against the shoulder.
- 3. Let the bearings cool to room temperature before you continue.", "summary": "Heat each bearing (KP-200-130) to 110 C on the induction heater.", "children": []}, {"node_id": "0008", "title": "4.3 Fit the Lip Seals", "level": 2, "page_start": 1, "page_end": 1, "text": "- 1. Press a bearing lip seal (KP-200-131) into each end cover with the lip facing outward.
- 2. Fit the end covers and torque the cover screws to 12 Nm.", "summary": "Press a bearing lip seal (KP-200-131) into each end cover with the lip facing outward.", "children": []}]}, {"node_id": "0009", "title": "5 Rotating Assembly", "level": 1, "page_start": 1, "page_end": 3, "text": "", "summary": "Covers: 5.1 Shaft Sleeve; 5.2 Mechanical Seal; 5.3 Impeller; 5.4 Balance Check", "children": [{"node_id": "0010", "title": "5.1 Shaft Sleeve", "level": 2, "page_start": 1, "page_end": 1, "text": "- 1. Apply anti-seize compound to the shaft.
- 2. Slide the shaft sleeve (KP-200-111) on until it meets the shoulder.", "summary": "Apply anti-seize compound to the shaft.", "children": []}, {"node_id": "0011", "title": "5.2 Mechanical Seal", "level": 2, "page_start": 1, "page_end": 2, "text": "- 1. Set the mechanical seal assembly (KP-200-114) to a working length of 42.5 mm with the setting gauge.
- 2. Lubricate the seal faces with clean water only.
- 3. Slide the seal onto the sleeve and tighten the grub screws to 4 Nm.", "summary": "Set the mechanical seal assembly (KP-200-114) to a working length of 42.5 mm with the setting gauge.", "children": []}, {"node_id": "0012", "title": "5.3 Impeller", "level": 2, "page_start": 3, "page_end": 3, "text": "- 1. Fit the impeller key and slide the impeller (KP-200-120) onto the shaft.
- 2. Fit the impeller nut (KP-200-121) and torque it to 95 Nm.
- 3. Check that the shaft turns freely by hand.", "summary": "Fit the impeller key and slide the impeller (KP-200-120) onto the shaft.", "children": []}, {"node_id": "0013", "title": "5.4 Balance Check", "level": 2, "page_start": 3, "page_end": 3, "text": "- 1. Mount the rotating assembly on the balancing stand.
- 2. The residual unbalance must be below grade G6.3. Record the reading.", "summary": "Mount the rotating assembly on the balancing stand.", "children": []}]}, {"node_id": "0014", "title": "6 Casing and Final Assembly", "level": 1, "page_start": 3, "page_end": 3, "text": "", "summary": "Covers: 6.1 Casing Closure; 6.2 Coupling and Alignment; 6.3 Instruments", "children": [{"node_id": "0015", "title": "6.1 Casing Closure", "level": 2, "page_start": 3, "page_end": 3, "text": "- 1. Fit a new casing O-ring (KP-200-115) in the casing groove.
- 2. Lower the back pull-out unit into the casing (KP-200-101) with the hoist.
- 3. Torque the casing bolts to 55 Nm in a cross pattern, in two passes.", "summary": "Fit a new casing O-ring (KP-200-115) in the casing groove.", "children": []}, {"node_id": "0016", "title": "6.2 Coupling and Alignment", "level": 2, "page_start": 3, "page_end": 3, "text": "- 1. Fit the flexible coupling (KP-200-140) halves.
- 2. Align the motor to within 0.05 mm offset and 0.05 mm/100 mm angularity.
- 3. Fit the coupling guard.", "summary": "Fit the flexible coupling (KP-200-140) halves.", "children": []}, {"node_id": "0017", "title": "6.3 Instruments", "level": 2, "page_start": 3, "page_end": 3, "text": "- 1. Fit the pressure gauge (KP-200-150) on the discharge flange with PTFE tape.", "summary": "Fit the pressure gauge (KP-200-150) on the discharge flange with PTFE tape.", "children": []}]}, {"node_id": "0018", "title": "7 Testing", "level": 1, "page_start": 4, "page_end": 4, "text": "", "summary": "Covers: 7.1 Hydrostatic Test; 7.2 Performance Run", "children": [{"node_id": "0019", "title": "7.1 Hydrostatic Test", "level": 2, "page_start": 4, "page_end": 4, "text": "- 1. Fill the casing with water and pressurise to 24 bar (1.5 x max casing pressure).
- 2. Hold for 10 minutes. No visible leakage is allowed.", "summary": "Fill the casing with water and pressurise to 24 bar (1.5 x max casing pressure).", "children": []}, {"node_id": "0020", "title": "7.2 Performance Run", "level": 2, "page_start": 4, "page_end": 4, "text": "- 1. Run the pump at rated speed for 30 minutes on the test loop.
- 2. Record flow, head, current and bearing temperatures every 10 minutes.
- 3. Bearing temperature must stay below 80 C.", "summary": "Run the pump at rated speed for 30 minutes on the test loop.", "children": []}]}, {"node_id": "0021", "title": "8 Packing and Dispatch", "level": 1, "page_start": 4, "page_end": 4, "text": "- 1. Drain the pump and blow the casing dry with oil-free air.
- 2. Fit flange covers, attach the test certificate and pack on a pallet.", "summary": "Drain the pump and blow the casing dry with oil-free air.", "children": []}]
